entities.name: Red Army intervention in Afghanistan (1929)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Red Army intervention in Afghanistan in 1929 also known as the First Soviet Intervention in Afghanistan of 1929 was a special operation aimed at supporting the ousted king of Afghanistan, Amanullah Khan, against the Saqqawists and Basmachi.
